name: Cross-Body Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: A unique triceps isolation movement where a dumbbell is lowered across the body to the opposite shoulder. This creates a distinctive stretch on the triceps long head from an oblique angle. The movement offers a different stimulus than standard overhead extensions.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Cross-Body Dumbbell Triceps Extension in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Cross-Body Dumbbell Triceps Extension.
steps: Step 1: Lie on bench holding one dumbbell with arm extended toward ceiling.
Step 2: Bend elbow to lower dumbbell across body toward opposite shoulder.
Step 3: Lower until forearm is parallel to floor or slight stretch is felt.
Step 4: Extend arm back to straight position above chest.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Moving shoulder joint instead of elbow
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Feel the cross-body stretch at the bottom
